verdict.rationale: Bruno exposes a CLI (bru) that can run collections, generate reports, and integrate with CI/CD (bruno-docs-1,2,3, bruno-probe-4), giving some programmatic parity, but there is no formal REST/GraphQL API (openapi probe returns 404, bruno-probe-2) and community reports note missing features like OAuth2, cookies, GraphQL, WebSockets that are core to UI usage (bruno-comm-3,4,5), so CLI access does not fully mirror UI capabilities.
